climate: Grenache sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A southern Rhône Valley appellation making two kinds of wine: sweet fortified vin doux naturel as Muscat de Beaumes de Venise, and red Côtes du Rhône Villages. Its rules list Grenache first, with Syrah and Mourvèdre as other grapes.
